Tamil Nadu reduces MK Stalin's security cover

The Tamil Nadu government has reduced the security cover for former Chief Minister MK Stalin from Z+ to Z category. The number of personnel assigned to his security detail has been decreased from 54 to 34. This decision was made by the current government.
